result.instructions: Tools for Deskpro, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Deskpro data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run deskpro_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run deskpro_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run deskpro_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. deskpro_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: deskpro_get_me
tools.title: Get the authenticated agent
tools.description: Return who the API key acts as — the auth method, the bound person id and their profile. A cheap way to confirm the helpdesk URL and key are right. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/me.

tools.name: deskpro_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List tickets, filtered by status, assigned agent, requester, organization, department or labels, and sorted. Returns ticket objects (id, ref, subject, ticket_status, agent, person, department, urgency, labels, dates) plus pagination meta. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/tickets.

status.description: Only tickets in this status, e.g. awaiting_agent, awaiting_user, pending, resolved.

agent.description: Only tickets assigned to this agent id.

person.description: Only tickets raised by this person id.

organization.description: Only tickets from this organization id.

department.description: Only tickets in this department id.

include.description: Comma-separated related object types to side-load into the response's `linked` section, e.g. person,agent,department,organization.

tools.name: deskpro_get_ticket
tools.title: Get one ticket
tools.description: Fetch a single ticket by id, with its subject, status, assignment, requester, labels, custom fields, SLA state and timing. A merged ticket redirects to the ticket it was merged into. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/tickets/{id}.

include.description: Comma-separated related object types to side-load into the response's `linked` section, e.g. person,agent,department,organization.

tools.name: deskpro_list_ticket_messages
tools.title: List a ticket's messages
tools.description: List the conversation on one ticket — every reply and agent note, with its author, date, is_agent_note flag and HTML body. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/tickets/{id}/messages.

include.description: Comma-separated related object types to side-load into the response's `linked` section, e.g. person,agent,department,organization.

tools.name: deskpro_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List people (end users and agents), searchable by name and filterable by email, organization or agent flag. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/people.

primary_email.description: Only the person with this primary email.

organization.description: Only members of these organization ids (comma-separated).

is_agent.description: true for agents only, false for end users only.

include.description: Comma-separated related object types to side-load into the response's `linked` section, e.g. person,agent,department,organization.

tools.name: deskpro_get_person
tools.title: Get one person
tools.description: Fetch a single person by id — name, emails, phone numbers, organization, labels, custom fields and ticket count. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/people/{id}.

include.description: Comma-separated related object types to side-load into the response's `linked` section, e.g. person,agent,department,organization.

tools.name: deskpro_list_person_tickets
tools.title: List a person's tickets
tools.description: List the tickets raised by one person — their support history. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/people/{id}/tickets.

tools.name: deskpro_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List customer organizations, filterable by name or labels. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/organizations.

name.description: Only the organization with this name.

include.description: Comma-separated related object types to side-load into the response's `linked` section, e.g. person,agent,department,organization.

tools.name: deskpro_get_organization
tools.title: Get one organization
tools.description: Fetch a single organization by id — name, summary, email domains, labels, custom fields and ticket count. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/organizations/{id}.

include.description: Comma-separated related object types to side-load into the response's `linked` section, e.g. person,agent,department,organization.

tools.name: deskpro_list_organization_tickets
tools.title: List an organization's tickets
tools.description: List the tickets belonging to one organization. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/organizations/{id}/tickets.

tools.name: deskpro_list_articles
tools.title: List knowledgebase articles
tools.description: List knowledgebase articles, filterable by category, status and author. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/articles.

category.description: Only articles in this category id.

author.description: Only articles by this author id, or 'me' for the key's agent.

tools.name: deskpro_get_article
tools.title: Get one article
tools.description: Fetch a single knowledgebase article by id — title, content, status, categories and labels. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/articles/{id}.

tools.name: deskpro_list_departments
tools.title: List ticket departments
tools.description: List the ticket departments (id, title, parent, whether tickets/chat are enabled) — needed to route a new ticket. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/ticket_departments.

tools.name: deskpro_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List the helpdesk's agents (id, name, email, online state) — needed to assign a ticket. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/agents.

tools.name: deskpro_list_ticket_statuses
tools.title: List ticket statuses
tools.description: List the ticket statuses and custom sub-statuses (status_type, status_code, title) configured on the helpdesk. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/ticket_statuses.

tools.name: deskpro_search
tools.title: Search the helpdesk
tools.description: Quick search across tickets, people, organizations, articles, news, downloads, community topics and chats; results are grouped by type. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/search.

types.description: Comma-separated types to search, e.g. ticket,person,organization. Omit for all.

tools.name: deskpro_create_ticket
tools.title: Create a ticket
tools.description: Open a new ticket for a requester (by person id, or by email — Deskpro creates the person if the email is new) with a first message. Depending on the helpdesk's triggers this may email the requester. Returns the created ticket. Deskpro: POST /api/v2/tickets.

message_format.description: Format of the message body. Default text.

person_email.description: The requester's email (used when person_id is not given).

person_name.description: The requester's name, for a new person.

agent_team.description: Assign to this agent team id.

status.description: Ticket status: awaiting_agent, awaiting_user, pending or resolved, optionally with a custom sub-status id suffix (e.g. pending.5 — see deskpro_list_ticket_statuses). The hidden (deleted/spam) status is not settable here.

tools.name: deskpro_update_ticket
tools.title: Update a ticket
tools.description: Change a ticket's subject, status, assignment, department, organization, urgency, hold state or labels. Only the fields you pass are sent. Reversible by updating again. Cannot set the hidden (deleted/spam) status. Deskpro: PUT /api/v2/tickets/{id}.

status.description: Ticket status: awaiting_agent, awaiting_user, pending or resolved, optionally with a custom sub-status id suffix (e.g. pending.5 — see deskpro_list_ticket_statuses). The hidden (deleted/spam) status is not settable here.

agent_team.description: Assign to this agent team id.

is_hold.description: Put the ticket on hold (true) or take it off hold (false).

tools.name: deskpro_add_ticket_message
tools.title: Reply to a ticket or add a note
tools.description: Add a message to a ticket as the key's agent. With is_note=true it is an internal agent note (not shown to the requester); with is_note=false it is a REPLY that the helpdesk emails to the requester — that cannot be unsent. Deskpro: POST /api/v2/tickets/{id}/messages.

format.description: Format of the body. Default text.

is_note.description: true = internal agent note; false = public reply to the requester.

annotations.title: Reply to a ticket or add a note

tools.name: deskpro_create_organization
tools.title: Create an organization
tools.description: Create a customer organization. Email domains auto-associate people with matching addresses. Deskpro: POST /api/v2/organizations.

email_domains.description: Email domains belonging to the organization, e.g. example.com.
